title: Analysis Run Metadata
description: Provenance and configuration metadata for a single analysis run. Anchored at chapter level, one per scope file. All other items in the scope were produced by this run configuration.

model.description: Primary analyst model used to produce observations in this scope.

critic_model.description: Model used for the critic review loop, if applicable.

analysis_mode.description: Whether expert materials (InterpreSure annotations, BART, MACULA) were provided to the analyst.

analysis_type.description: The primary observation type produced by this run (e.g. interpresure_suggestions, translator_questions).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the run was executed.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag (e.g. en, es-419, vi).

biblical_language.description: Biblical source language used for analysis.

resources.description: Flags indicating which enrichment resources were available and used during this run.

interpresure.description: Whether InterpreSure expert annotations were provided.

bart.description: Whether BART discourse annotations were provided (Greek only).

macula.description: Whether MACULA syntax tree tokens were provided (Greek only).

discourse_boundary_markers.description: Whether discourse boundary markers were injected into the verse loop.
